simple.meaning: כֶּשֶׂד (Kesed) is a Hebrew word meaning “Kesed , a relative of Abraham.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H3777. Kesed כֶּ֫שֶׂד proper name, masculine son of Nahor according to Gen 22:22 (J; perhaps originally personified, or assumed ancestor, of following, see Di Dl Par 201 ).
